description: Invokes a method of a model object by handle (args coerced to the parameter types; {"$handle":N} passes another object). Maps to POST /obj/{handle}/invoke. M-off. Powerful — combine with tia_obj_info to see the signature. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs every guard the real call runs (the member policy, the overload and argument checks and, on a Version Control object, the leaf guard: a container argument is 409 vci_not_leaf) and answers {dryRun:true, status:"plan_ok", handle, type, member, parameters} WITHOUT invoking the member; the plan never echoes an argument. A serve that does not advertise supportsObjInvokeDryRun:true on GET /status would take dryRun for noise and invoke the member, so the dry run is refused as obj_invoke_dry_run_unsupported before any POST.
